C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including common denominators, common denominator conversion, borrowing, normalization of improper mixed numbers, and simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with a shared denominator before subtracting.
Tag for mixed-number subtraction if only the fractional parts need denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere subtraction of numerators after denominators already match.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 over a denominator unless it is part of denominator alignment.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the common denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver subtracts fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when the solver subtracts only the fractional parts of mixed numbers after denominators are aligned.
Tag whether the equal denominators were given originally or obtained through conversion.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding or creating the common denominator itself.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole-number part to fix a negative fractional difference.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction.

skills.name: Subtract whole and combine
skills.definition: Subtract whole-number parts and combine the whole and fractional results into a final mixed number, fraction, or integer when no borrowing adjustment is needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver subtracts whole-number parts in a mixed-number or whole-number-minus-mixed-number problem.
Tag when the solver combines a whole-part result with a fractional-part result into the final answer.
Tag when the combined result is an integer because the fractional part is zero or the whole part is zero.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure fraction-minus-fraction items with no whole-number part.
Do not tag the borrowing step itself; that belongs to borrowing/regrouping.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction.

skills.name: Borrow in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole-number part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is rewritten as denominator-over-denominator and added to the existing fractional part.
Tag when borrowing is used in whole-minus-fraction, whole-minus-mixed, or mixed-minus-mixed subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction of whole parts or fraction parts when no regrouping occurs.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Do not tag simplification after the borrowed subtraction is completed.

skills.name: Rewrite whole or mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number as a mixed number with a zero fractional part or normalize a mixed number whose fractional part is improper into standard mixed-number form before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator to align mixed-number subtraction.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when this rewriting prepares the quantities for later whole-part and fraction-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding an LCD or converting ordinary fractions to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing during subtraction; borrowing happens after subtraction setup.
Do not tag final combination of whole and fraction parts.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the subtraction result to lowest terms or convert a zero-valued fraction to 0 or an equivalent integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when the final answer is expressed in lowest terms after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a fraction in lowest terms with no explicit simplification.
Do not tag combining whole and fraction parts unless reduction is also performed.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction.

A.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators are different.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtracting.
Tag for mixed-number subtraction if only the fractional parts need denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere subtraction of numerators after denominators already match.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 over a denominator unless equivalent-fraction conversion is also performed.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole or mixed-number operand into a subtraction-ready form, such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as a mixed number with fractional part 0.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed number like 3 + 0/5 or 2 + 0/8.
Tag when this rewriting is used to align whole and fractional parts for later subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding a common denominator between nonzero fractional parts.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts separately when the quantities are already aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately without borrowing.
Tag when a step computes an intermediate negative fractional difference before borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag denominator-finding or equivalent-fraction conversion.
Do not tag the borrowing/regrouping step itself.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction.

skills.name: Borrow in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units and adjust the whole part when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted into denominator-sized fractional units such as 3/3, 10/10, or 24/24.
Tag when borrowing resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as having fractional part 0 before any need to borrow is addressed.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-valued fraction to 0 or an integer when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when the final result is expressed in lowest terms after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a lowest-term fraction without any simplification action shown.
Do not tag combining whole and fractional parts unless simplification is explicitly performed there.
Do not tag normalization of operands before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final answer
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number part and fractional part into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fractional results are recombined into one final number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when a whole part plus zero fraction is expressed as an integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction computations that produce the parts.
Do not tag simplification of a fraction unless the step's main action is recombination.
Do not tag denominator alignment or borrowing.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including common denominators, unlike denominators, borrowing, normalization, and simplification

skills.name: Make common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike fractional parts.
Tag when a step rewrites one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
Tag for mixed-number subtraction if only the fractional parts are converted to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere subtraction of numerators after common denominators are already established.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 over a denominator unless it is part of denominator matching by explicit fraction conversion.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a nonstandard mixed number or whole-number term into a compatible form for subtraction, such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or writing a whole number as a mixed number with fractional part 0.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed number like a + 0/b to align whole and fractional parts.
Tag when the rewrite is done to prepare for part-by-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary equivalent-fraction conversion used only to create a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution subtracts whole and fractional parts separately after setup is complete.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding an LCD or converting to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping after a negative fractional difference appears.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted into denominator-sized fractional units and added to the existing fractional part.
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag simple subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a + 0/b before any need to borrow arises.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or recognize that a zero fraction equals 0 or that the fractional part disappears.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is explicitly reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when a zero fraction like 0/3 or 0/8 is simplified to 0 or removed from the final answer.
Tag when the final result is expressed in lowest terms after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction itself.
Do not tag combining whole and fractional parts unless simplification is explicitly performed.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final answer
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional parts into a single final value in fraction, mixed-number, or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fractional results are recombined into a mixed number.
Tag when a solution states that whole and fractional parts together give a proper fraction or integer final answer.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted in the final expression.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction of whole or fractional parts.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly combines parts.
Do not tag setup steps such as normalization or common-denominator conversion.
